qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow: MVSc. / M.Tech. / MSc. Degree in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Immunology with 2 years' experience in R&D in the related area. Experience in cell culture, animal experiments, immuno assay ELISA/FACS, and Molecular biology. Experience in working in BSL3 laboratory with Mycobacterium tuberculosis based research will be preferred. Senior Project Assistant: Graduate Degree in Arts/ Science/ commerce or Business management and at least 5 years of experience in the actual conduct of meetings and adequate experience of supervisory work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIAB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIAB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Staff positions at NIAB is 23rd September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for Project Staff positions at the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology. These include one Senior Research Fellow and one Senior Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: For the Senior Research Fellow position, candidates must possess an MVSc., M.Tech., or MSc. Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or Immunology, along with 2 years of relevant R&D experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Senior Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Assistant position is 50 years. Candidates should ensure they meet this criterion before applying.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 per month plus HRA, if applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NIAB Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications, followed by intimation via email to shortlisted candidates. The final selection will be based on an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for NIAB Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article. It contains comprehensive details about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for NIAB Recruitment 2026 must be submitted strictly through the online mode. Offline applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions at the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology, located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500 032.
